goal.title: JEE Mains & Advanced Preparation
goal.tagline: Comprehensive Master Plan for Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics Mastery
goal.description: Official NTA & IIT JEE Advanced syllabus coverage with deep conceptual rigor, formula derivation, Physics Galaxy illustrations, NCERT Chemistry foundations, MathonGo PYQ drills, and JoSAA admission guidance.
targetRoles: Top 1% All India Rank in JEE Main & Advanced
Admissions to IITs, NITs, IIITs & BITS
B.Tech in Computer Science / Electrical / Core Engineering

careerPath.title: Stage 1: Core Conceptual Foundations & NCERT Mastery
careerPath.subtitle: Class 11 & 12 Fundamentals Across PCM
careerPath.description: Build rigorous foundational concepts in Mechanics, Physical Chemistry, and Algebra. Ensure zero conceptual gaps using NCERT and standard theory.
milestones: Complete all NCERT textbook reading and in-text problems in Chemistry
Derive every fundamental law in Physics (Kinematics, Newton's Laws, Work-Energy)
Maintain a dedicated Formula & Theorem Notebook for daily revision

careerPath.title: Stage 2: Standard Problem Solving & JEE Main Mastery
careerPath.subtitle: Speed, Accuracy & Chapter-wise PYQ Drills
careerPath.description: Develop numerical dexterity and quick dimensional/elimination techniques required to crack JEE Main with 99+ percentile.
milestones: Solve 10+ years of chapter-wise JEE Main Previous Year Questions (PYQs)
Practice timed 60-minute sectional problem sets for speed and accuracy
Identify and eliminate repeated negative marking errors

careerPath.title: Stage 3: Advanced Problem Solving & Multi-Concept Drills
careerPath.subtitle: JEE Advanced Depth, Mixed Concepts & Rigorous Analysis
careerPath.description: Tackle multi-concept, multi-correct, comprehension, and matrix-match questions designed for JEE Advanced rank maximization.
milestones: Complete Physics Galaxy Advanced Illustrations and challenging problems
Solve 15 years of JEE Advanced subjective and objective PYQs
Master multi-chapter synthesis (e.g. Calculus in Mechanics, Thermodynamics in Physical Chemistry)

careerPath.title: Stage 4: National Exam Simulation & CBT Conditioning
careerPath.subtitle: Full 3-Hour Computer Based Tests & Error Log Auditing
careerPath.description: Simulate real exam conditions (Paper 1 & Paper 2) to build mental stamina, exam temperament, and time allocation strategy.
milestones: Complete 20+ full-length 3-hour Computer Based Mock Tests (CBTs)
Maintain an Error Logbook: categorize errors into silly mistakes, conceptual gaps, or time pressure
Achieve consistent 99+ percentile performance across mock series

careerPath.title: Stage 5: JoSAA Counselling, Seat Allocation & College Enrollment
careerPath.subtitle: Official JoSAA / CSAB Strategy, Choice Filling & Institute Selection
careerPath.description: Navigate the official Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) process, rank analytics, choice prioritization, and document verification.
milestones: Analyze opening and closing ranks for IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs across prior years
Lock optimal prioritized choice order based on genuine branch interest and institute tier
Complete seat acceptance, fee payment, and physical reporting at the allocated institute

roadmap.title: JEE Mains & Advanced Official Syllabus Roadmap

stages.title: Physics: Mechanics & Properties of Matter
stages.shortSummary: Units, Dimensions, Kinematics, Newton's Laws, Work-Energy, Center of Mass, Rotation, Gravitation & Fluids.
stages.subject: Physics

topics.title: Units, Dimensions, Errors & Practical Physics
topics.description: SI units, dimensional analysis, propagation of errors, significant figures, Vernier calipers, and screw gauge.
subtopics: Dimensional homogeneity
Error analysis in experiments
Vernier calipers & micrometer screw gauge
Least count calculations
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Guaranteed 1-2 direct numerical/MCQ questions in JEE Main.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Essential for experimental physics questions and multi-concept calculations.
practiceTasks: Solve 20 error propagation questions
Practice virtual Vernier and screw gauge readings

topics.title: Vectors & Kinematics (1D, 2D & Relative Motion)
topics.description: Scalar and vector products, motion in a straight line, projectile motion, and relative velocity in 1D/2D.
subtopics: 1D motion under constant & variable acceleration
Graph analysis (x-t, v-t, a-t)
Ground-to-ground and oblique projectiles
Relative velocity & river-boat / rain-man problems
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Core foundation testing direct formula and graph interpretations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Complex multi-body relative motion and constraints in 2D and 3D.
practiceTasks: Solve 30 projectile motion problems including inclined planes
Master 20 relative velocity problems

topics.title: Newton's Laws of Motion, Constraints & Friction
topics.description: Free body diagrams, inertial & non-inertial frames, pseudo force, static & kinetic friction, circular dynamics.
subtopics: String and wedge constraint relations
Equilibrium of concurrent forces
Friction on rough inclined surfaces
Banking of tracks & vertical circular motion
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Frequent questions on block-on-block friction and pulley constraints.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Intricate multi-body frictional threshold analysis and non-inertial frame dynamics.
practiceTasks: Solve 25 two-block friction problems
Derive critical velocity in vertical loop

topics.title: Work, Energy, Power & Collisions
topics.description: Work-energy theorem, conservative forces, potential energy functions, power, elastic and inelastic collisions in 1D/2D.
subtopics: Variable force work integration
Potential energy curve stability (stable/unstable equilibrium)
Coefficient of restitution (e)
Direct and oblique collisions
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Standard applications of conservation laws and power equations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Coupled spring-mass-collision problems requiring simultaneous conservation of momentum and energy.
practiceTasks: Solve 25 collision problems with varying restitution
Analyze potential energy U(x) graphs for equilibrium

topics.title: Rotational Mechanics & Rigid Body Dynamics
topics.description: Center of mass, moment of inertia theorems, torque, angular momentum conservation, rolling without slipping.
subtopics: Center of mass of standard bodies
Parallel & perpendicular axis theorems
Torque and angular acceleration (tau = I*alpha)
Conservation of angular momentum
Pure rolling on flat & inclined planes
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Moment of inertia calculations and direct torque equations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Top-tier chapter in JEE Advanced: combined translation + rotation, instantaneous center of rotation, toppling vs sliding.
practiceTasks: Calculate moment of inertia for composite geometries
Solve 20 pure rolling dynamics problems on rough inclines

topics.title: Gravitation & Mechanical Properties of Solids and Fluids
topics.description: Kepler's laws, gravitational potential & orbital velocity, Hooke's law, hydrostatic pressure, Pascal's law, Archimedes principle, Bernoulli theorem, viscosity, surface tension.
subtopics: Escape velocity and satellite orbits
Stress-strain curve and Young's modulus
Pascal law and manometer problems
Equation of continuity and Bernoulli equation
Surface tension, capillarity and terminal velocity
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct scoring questions on satellite energy, Bernoulli theorem, and Young modulus.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Fluid acceleration in moving tanks, capillary rise thermodynamics, and variable mass orbits.
practiceTasks: Solve 20 satellite orbital energy problems
Apply Bernoulli theorem to siphon and draining tanks

stages.milestoneOutcome: Complete mastery over classical mechanics and fluid principles, unlocking 35-40% of the JEE Physics syllabus.

stages.title: Physics: Electrodynamics & Magnetism
stages.shortSummary: Electrostatics, Gauss's Law, Capacitance, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects, EMI & Alternating Current.
stages.subject: Physics

topics.title: Electrostatics, Electric Field & Gauss's Law
topics.description: Coulomb's law, electric field intensity and potential, electric dipoles, flux through closed surfaces, applications of Gauss's law.
subtopics: Field due to continuous charge distributions (ring, disc, wire, sphere)
Electric potential and field gradient (E = -grad V)
Gauss's law for symmetric configurations
Conductors in electrostatic equilibrium & shielding
topics.jeeMainRelevance: High-yield topic with 2-3 questions covering dipole moment, flux, and spherical potentials.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Conductor cavity problems with induced charges, earthing of concentric shells, and electrical energy integration.
practiceTasks: Solve concentric spherical conducting shell problems with earthing
Calculate electric field of uniformly charged hemisphere

topics.title: Capacitors & Dielectrics
topics.description: Parallel plate capacitor, combination in series/parallel, energy stored, dielectric insertion effects, and RC charging/discharging circuits.
subtopics: Capacitance with multiple dielectric slabs
Force between capacitor plates
Energy density in electrostatic field
Transient analysis in RC circuits (charging & discharging)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Standard equivalent capacitance networks and dielectric insertion questions.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Variable capacitance systems with mechanical springs, and differential equation based RC networks.
practiceTasks: Solve 15 bridge capacitor circuits with dielectric boundaries
Derive time-dependent charge q(t) in RC circuit

topics.title: Current Electricity & Electrical Instruments
topics.description: Ohm's law, drift velocity, resistivity, temperature dependence, Kirchhoff's rules, Wheatstone bridge, meter bridge, and potentiometer.
subtopics: Microscopic model of conduction (I = n*e*A*v_d)
Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws (KCL/KVL)
Symmetry-based circuit simplification (cubic and infinite ladders)
Galvanometer conversion to ammeter and voltmeter
Potentiometer sensitivity and comparisons
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Consistently tested with 2 questions on instrument error analysis and equivalent resistance.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Non-linear circuit elements, nodal analysis, and temperature-dependent resistance integration.
practiceTasks: Solve 20 resistor cube and infinite grid networks
Calculate shunt and multiplier values for galvanometer conversion

topics.title: Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism
topics.description: Biot-Savart law, Ampere's circuital law, Lorentz force on moving charges, torque on magnetic dipoles, Earth's magnetism, and magnetic materials.
subtopics: Magnetic field of circular loop, straight wire and solenoid
Motion of charged particles in uniform E and B fields (helical paths)
Force between parallel currents
Moving coil galvanometer
Dia, para, and ferromagnetic material classification
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Magnetic field formulas for standard geometries and cyclotron frequency calculations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Helical motion in non-uniform fields, magnetic pressure, and magnetic boundary conditions.
practiceTasks: Calculate B-field on axis of Helmholtz coils
Solve 15 magnetic torque and magnetic dipole oscillation problems

topics.title: Electromagnetic Induction (EMI) & Alternating Current (AC)
topics.description: Faraday's laws, Lenz's law, motional EMF, self and mutual inductance, AC circuits (LCR series), resonance, power factor, and transformers.
subtopics: Motional EMF in rotating and sliding rods
Induced electric field (non-conservative)
LCR series AC circuit phasor diagrams
Resonance frequency, Quality factor (Q) and power factor
LR and LC oscillation circuits
topics.jeeMainRelevance: LCR circuit impedance, resonance frequency, and transformer turns ratio.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Motional EMF with mechanical resistance and terminal velocity, non-conservative electric field loops, and mutual inductance coefficients.
practiceTasks: Solve sliding conducting rod on rails in magnetic field with resistor
Draw phasor diagrams and calculate resonance frequency for series LCR

stages.milestoneOutcome: Mastery of Maxwellian classical electrodynamics and circuit analysis, forming 30% of the JEE Physics exam weightage.

stages.title: Physics: Thermodynamics, Oscillations, Optics & Modern Physics
stages.shortSummary: Thermal Expansion, Kinetic Theory, First & Second Laws of Thermodynamics, SHM, Sound Waves, Ray Optics, Wave Optics, Modern Physics & Semiconductors.
stages.subject: Physics

topics.title: Thermal Physics & Thermodynamics
topics.description: Thermal expansion, calorimetry, heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation, Stefan-Boltzmann law), kinetic theory of gases, first and second laws of thermodynamics.
subtopics: Calorimetry water equivalent & phase changes
Conduction through composite slabs & Wien displacement law
Kinetic theory of gases (rms speed, degrees of freedom, equipartition)
First law of thermodynamics (Q = delta U + W) for PV cycles
Carnot engine efficiency and PV/TS cycle analysis
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Extremely high yield: 2-3 direct questions on PV diagrams, efficiency, and conduction.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Piston-cylinder setups coupled with springs, adiabatic gas mixture expansions, and entropy change calculations.
practiceTasks: Calculate work done and efficiency in triangular and elliptical PV cycles
Solve composite bar heat conduction problems

topics.title: Oscillations (SHM) & Mechanical Waves
topics.description: Simple harmonic motion kinematics and dynamics, spring-mass systems, simple and physical pendulums, wave equation, sound speed, standing waves, beats, Doppler effect.
subtopics: SHM differential equation and energy conservation
Series and parallel spring combinations
Wave equation y = A*sin(kx - omega*t)
Standing waves in strings and organ pipes
Beats and Doppler effect for moving source/observer
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Standard Doppler frequency shifts, organ pipe resonance lengths, and time periods.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Coupled oscillators, physical pendulum center of oscillation, and acoustic reflection phase shifts.
practiceTasks: Solve 20 Doppler effect scenarios with wind velocity
Calculate resonance frequencies in closed and open organ pipes

topics.title: Ray Optics & Optical Instruments
topics.description: Reflection, refraction at plane and spherical surfaces, total internal reflection, thin lenses, lens maker's formula, prisms, microscopes, and telescopes.
subtopics: Snell's law and critical angle
Refraction at single spherical interface
Lens maker's formula and combination of lenses/mirrors
Prism dispersion and minimum deviation angle
Magnifying power of astronomical telescope and compound microscope
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct scoring questions on lens-mirror combinations, silvered lenses, and prism deviation.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Variable refractive index media ray tracing, aberration considerations, and multi-component optical matrices.
practiceTasks: Solve 20 silvered lens-mirror combination problems
Calculate minimum deviation and dispersive power for standard prisms

topics.title: Wave Optics
topics.description: Huygens' principle, interference of light, Young's double slit experiment (YDSE), diffraction at a single slit, and polarization.
subtopics: Coherent sources and optical path difference
YDSE fringe width and intensity distribution
YDSE with mica sheet in one beam path
Single slit Fraunhofer diffraction minima and central maxima width
Brewster's law and Malus's law of polarization
topics.jeeMainRelevance: YDSE fringe shift with thin transparent slab and Brewster angle calculations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: YDSE with multiple slits, non-monochromatic source interference, and intensity distribution integrals.
practiceTasks: Calculate fringe shift upon inserting thin glass sheet in YDSE
Solve single-slit diffraction intensity ratio problems

topics.title: Modern Physics & Semiconductor Devices
topics.description: Photoelectric effect, de Broglie wavelength, Bohr model of hydrogen atom, atomic spectra, nuclear physics (binding energy, radioactivity), semiconductors (p-n junction, diodes, logic gates).
subtopics: Einstein's photoelectric equation & stopping potential graphs
Bohr orbital radius, velocity, and energy transitions (Lyman, Balmer)
Mass defect, binding energy per nucleon curve, alpha/beta decay laws
p-n junction diode forward/reverse bias, Zener diode as voltage regulator
Logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR) truth tables
topics.jeeMainRelevance: The single highest return-on-time topic: 3-4 straightforward questions guaranteed in every JEE Main session.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Recoil of atom upon photon emission, X-ray Moseley's law, and relativistic mass-energy conservation.
practiceTasks: Solve 25 Bohr transition and de Broglie wavelength problems
Design circuit using Zener diode for regulated voltage output

stages.milestoneOutcome: Completion of 100% of the JEE Physics curriculum, establishing high-accuracy scoring across classical and modern modules.

stages.title: Chemistry: Physical Chemistry Foundations & Equilibrium
stages.shortSummary: Mole Concept, Atomic Structure, Chemical Thermodynamics, Chemical & Ionic Equilibrium, Solutions, Electrochemistry & Kinetics.
stages.subject: Chemistry

topics.title: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry (Mole Concept & Stoichiometry)
topics.description: Atomic and molecular mass, mole concept, molar mass, percentage composition, empirical and molecular formula, stoichiometry, limiting reagent, and concentration terms.
subtopics: Molarity, Molality, Mole fraction, Normality, ppm
Balancing redox equations by ion-electron method
Limiting reagent and percentage yield calculations
Volumetric titration fundamentals (acid-base & redox)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Fundamental bedrock for all numerical Physical Chemistry questions.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Complex multi-step sequential and parallel reaction yield calculations.
practiceTasks: Solve 25 limiting reagent problems with sequential reactions
Convert between molarity, molality, and mole fraction for binary solutions

topics.title: Atomic Structure (Quantum Mechanical Model)
topics.description: Bohr's model and its limitations, dual nature of matter (de Broglie), Heisenberg uncertainty principle, quantum numbers, atomic orbitals, Pauli exclusion principle, Hund's rule, Aufbau principle.
subtopics: Wave particle duality and de Broglie wavelength
Heisenberg uncertainty principle equations
Quantum numbers (n, l, m, s) and orbital shapes
Radial and angular wave functions, radial probability distribution curves and nodes
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct questions on quantum numbers, nodes, and electronic configuration anomalies (Cr, Cu).
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Interpretation of radial probability distribution curves psi^2 vs r, and multi-electron orbital screening.
practiceTasks: Calculate total, radial, and angular nodes for 3d, 4p, and 5f orbitals
Solve Heisenberg uncertainty problems for subatomic particles

topics.title: Chemical Thermodynamics & Energetics
topics.description: System and surroundings, extensive and intensive properties, state functions, first law of thermodynamics, enthalpy, Hess's law, entropy, Gibbs free energy, and spontaneity criteria.
subtopics: Work done in reversible and irreversible isothermal/adiabatic expansions
Enthalpy of formation, combustion, neutralization, and bond dissociation
Second law of thermodynamics and entropy change calculation (delta S)
Gibbs free energy change (delta G = delta H - T*delta S) and equilibrium constant relation
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Calculation of delta H from bond enthalpies and spontaneous reaction temperature limits.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Rigorous delta G vs temperature plots (Ellingham diagram principles) and non-PV work thermodynamics.
practiceTasks: Calculate work in multi-stage reversible gas cycles
Determine temperature above which non-spontaneous endothermic reaction becomes spontaneous

topics.title: Chemical Equilibrium & Ionic Equilibrium
topics.description: Law of mass action, equilibrium constants (Kp and Kc), Le Chatelier's principle, pH scale, ionization of acids and bases, common ion effect, buffer solutions, salt hydrolysis, and solubility product (Ksp).
subtopics: Relation between Kp and Kc (Kp = Kc*(RT)^delta_n)
Le Chatelier's principle shifts with pressure, temperature, and inert gas addition
pH calculations of weak acids, polyprotic acids, and salt hydrolysis formulas
Acidic and basic buffer capacity (Henderson-Hasselbalch equation)
Solubility product Ksp and selective precipitation of cations
topics.jeeMainRelevance: High weightage: 2 numerical questions on buffer pH and precipitation conditions.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Simultaneous equilibrium, complex salt hydrolysis with amphiprotic anions, and indicator titration curves.
practiceTasks: Calculate pH of mixture of weak acid and strong base at equivalence point
Solve selective precipitation problems for mixed halides using Ksp

topics.title: Electrochemistry & Redox Reactions
topics.description: Galvanic cells, standard electrode potential, Nernst equation, Gibbs free energy of cell reaction, electrolytic conductance, Kohlrausch's law, electrolysis laws, batteries, and corrosion.
subtopics: EMF of galvanic cell and Nernst equation for non-standard concentrations
Kohlrausch's law of independent migration of ions
Molar conductivity vs concentration graphs for strong and weak electrolytes
Faraday's laws of electrolysis (mass deposited = Z*I*t)
Commercial cells (Lead storage, fuel cells)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Guaranteed question on Nernst equation cell potential and Kohlrausch law calculations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Concentration cells with and without transference, potentiometric titration endpoints, and Gibbs-Helmholtz cell relations.
practiceTasks: Calculate cell potential E_cell for concentration cell with varying ion activities
Apply Kohlrausch law to find limiting molar conductivity of weak electrolyte

topics.title: Chemical Kinetics & Surface Chemistry Fundamentals
topics.description: Rate of reaction, factors affecting rate, order and molecularity, zero and first order integrated rate laws, half-life, Arrhenius equation, activation energy, and catalysis.
subtopics: Differential and integrated rate laws for 0th and 1st order
Half-life period (t_1/2) calculations and radioactive decay analogy
Temperature dependence of rate constant (Arrhenius equation ln(k2/k1))
Catalysis mechanism and adsorption isotherms (Freundlich isotherm)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct numericals on first order half-life and activation energy calculations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Pseudo-first order kinetics with mechanism proposal, parallel and consecutive reaction rates.
practiceTasks: Derive integrated rate law for 1st order reaction
Calculate activation energy given rate constants at two temperatures

stages.milestoneOutcome: Complete mastery over numerical Physical Chemistry principles, delivering rapid, error-free accuracy in Section B.

stages.title: Chemistry: Inorganic Chemistry & Coordination Compounds
stages.shortSummary: Periodic Table Trends, Chemical Bonding, p-Block, d-Block & f-Block Elements, Coordination Compounds & Metallurgy Principles.
stages.subject: Chemistry

topics.title: Periodic Classification & Periodicity in Properties
topics.description: Modern periodic law, long form periodic table, periodic trends in atomic/ionic radii, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, electronegativity, and valence.
subtopics: Screening effect and effective nuclear charge (Slater's rules basics)
Anomalies in ionization enthalpy (Be vs B, N vs O)
Electron gain enthalpy trends (F vs Cl, O vs S)
Diagonal relationships and electronegativity scales (Pauling)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Straightforward memory and concept-based questions with zero ambiguity.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Subtle electronic configuration justifications and ionic radii of isoelectronic species.
practiceTasks: Rank 15 isoelectronic species by ionic radius
Explain first and second ionization enthalpy anomalies across period 2 and 3

topics.title: Chemical Bonding & Molecular Structure
topics.description: Ionic bond, lattice energy, Born-Haber cycle, covalent bond, Lewis dot structures, VSEPR theory, hybridization, dipole moment, Molecular Orbital Theory (MOT), and hydrogen bonding.
subtopics: VSEPR geometry and shape predictions for molecules with lone pairs
Hybridization (sp, sp2, sp3, sp3d, sp3d2) and steric number
Molecular Orbital Theory: bond order, magnetic properties of B2, C2, N2, O2, O2-, O2+
Intermolecular and intramolecular hydrogen bonding and physical property impacts
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Highest yield Inorganic chapter: 2-3 questions covering MOT bond order, dipole moments, and shapes.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Bent's rule, Berry pseudorotation, multi-center bonding (3c-2e in diborane), and back-bonding (p_pi-d_pi).
practiceTasks: Determine molecular geometry of SF4, XeF4, I3-, and ClF3 using VSEPR
Calculate bond orders and unpaired electrons for O2, O2+, O2-, O2(2-) using MOT

topics.title: p-Block Elements (Groups 13 to 18)
topics.description: Electronic configuration, general trends in physical and chemical properties, inert pair effect, allotropy, structures of oxides, halides, oxoacids of phosphorus, sulfur, and chlorine, noble gas compounds.
subtopics: Inert pair effect in heavier p-block elements (Tl, Pb, Bi)
Structure and anomalous properties of Boron and Diborane
Oxoacids of Phosphorus and Sulfur (basicity and oxidation states)
Xenon fluorides (XeF2, XeF4, XeF6) preparation, structures and hydrolysis
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct questions on oxidation states, acidic strength of oxoacids, and geometry of noble gas fluorides.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: In-depth reaction conditions, hydrolysis mechanisms of halides, and disproportionation reaction pathways.
practiceTasks: Draw structures and determine P-H, P-OH bonds in H3PO2, H3PO3, and H3PO4
Complete hydrolysis reactions of XeF4 and XeF6

topics.title: d- and f-Block Elements & Coordination Compounds
topics.description: General properties of transition elements, oxidation states, catalytic properties, magnetic properties, colored ions, potassium permanganate (KMnO4) and potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) preparation and reactions, Werner's theory, IUPAC nomenclature of coordination compounds, isomerism, crystal field theory (CFT), and bonding.
subtopics: Lanthanoid contraction and its consequences on 4d/5d elements
Oxidizing actions of KMnO4 and K2Cr2O7 in acidic, basic and neutral media
IUPAC nomenclature of coordination complexes
Geometrical and optical isomerism in coordination complexes
Crystal Field Theory (CFT): splitting in octahedral (delta_o) and tetrahedral (delta_t) fields, spectrochemical series, CFSE and high/low spin complexes
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Very high weightage: 2-3 questions on IUPAC naming, magnetic moment (spin-only formula), and isomerism.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Jahn-Teller distortion, inner vs outer orbital complexes, trans-effect, and synergistic bonding in metal carbonyls.
practiceTasks: Calculate CFSE and spin-only magnetic moment for [Fe(CN)6]4- vs [Fe(H2O)6]2+
Identify geometrical and optical isomers of [Co(en)2Cl2]+

stages.milestoneOutcome: Complete mastery over NCERT Inorganic facts and Coordination Chemistry theory, enabling 100% precision in under 15 minutes.

stages.title: Chemistry: Organic Chemistry Mechanisms & Functional Groups
stages.shortSummary: IUPAC, Isomerism, GOC (Inductive, Resonance, Hyperconjugation, Aromaticity), Hydrocarbons, Alkyl Halides, Alcohols, Carbonyl Compounds, Amines & Biomolecules.
stages.subject: Chemistry

topics.title: General Organic Chemistry (GOC) & Reaction Mechanisms
topics.description: Inductive effect, electromeric effect, resonance, mesomeric effect, hyperconjugation, aromaticity (Huckel's rule), carbocations, carbanions, free radicals stability, and nucleophiles/electrophiles.
subtopics: Resonance structures stability rules
Huckel's 4n+2 rule for aromatic, antiaromatic, and non-aromatic systems
Acidic and basic strength order of organic compounds (alcohols, phenols, carboxylic acids, amines)
Reaction intermediates stability and generation
topics.jeeMainRelevance: The foundation of all Organic Chemistry: 2 questions on acidity order, carbocation stability, and aromaticity.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Non-benzenoid aromatic ions, hyperconjugation vs inductive dominance in steric environments, and reactive intermediate lifetimes.
practiceTasks: Rank 20 substituted phenols and benzoic acids by acidic strength
Classify 15 ring systems as aromatic, anti-aromatic, or non-aromatic

topics.title: Isomerism & Stereochemistry
topics.description: Structural isomerism (chain, position, functional, metamerism, tautomerism) and stereoisomerism (geometrical isomerism cis/trans/E-Z, optical isomerism, enantiomers, diastereomers, meso compounds, and R/S configuration).
subtopics: Keto-enol tautomerism stability factors
Geometrical isomerism conditions and E/Z designation
Chirality, optical activity, plane of symmetry and center of inversion
Enantiomers, diastereomers, and calculation of total stereoisomers
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct questions identifying meso compounds, chiral centers, and number of stereoisomers.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Conformational analysis of cyclohexanes (chair conformations, 1,3-diaxial interactions) and stereospecific addition reactions.
practiceTasks: Calculate total stereoisomers for tartaric acid and 2,3-dichlorobutane
Draw most stable chair conformation of cis-1,4-di-tert-butylcyclohexane

topics.title: Hydrocarbons (Alkanes, Alkenes, Alkynes & Arenes)
topics.description: Preparation and reactions of alkanes (Wurtz, free radical halogenation), alkenes (electrophilic addition, Markovnikov's rule, ozonolysis), alkynes (acidity, hydration), and electrophilic aromatic substitution in benzene.
subtopics: Free radical halogenation mechanism and selectivity (bromination vs chlorination)
Electrophilic addition of HX and H2O to alkenes with carbocation rearrangement
Ozonolysis (reductive vs oxidative) for structural elucidation
Electrophilic aromatic substitution (nitration, halogenation, Friedel-Crafts alkylation and acylation)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Ozonolysis products for identifying unknown alkenes, and Friedel-Crafts limitations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Carbocation rearrangements (ring expansion/contraction), anti-Markovnikov peroxide addition, and activating/deactivating directing groups in di-substituted benzenes.
practiceTasks: Deduce alkene structure given ozonolysis products acetone and glyoxal
Predict major product of Friedel-Crafts alkylation of benzene with 1-chloropropane

topics.title: Haloalkanes, Haloarenes, Alcohols, Phenols & Ethers
topics.description: SN1 and SN2 substitution mechanisms, E1 and E2 elimination mechanisms, Saytzeff vs Hofmann elimination, preparation and properties of alcohols, phenols (Kolbe, Reimer-Tiemann), and ethers (Williamson synthesis).
subtopics: SN1 vs SN2 kinetics, stereochemical inversion (Walden inversion), and solvent effects
Lucas reagent test for distinguishing 1, 2, 3 degree alcohols
Reactions of Phenol: Kolbe-Schmitt reaction and Reimer-Tiemann reaction
Williamson ether synthesis mechanism and cleavage of ethers with excess HI
topics.jeeMainRelevance: High-yield testing of SN1 vs SN2 reactivity orders and cleavage of unsymmetrical ethers with HI.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Neighboring group participation (NGP), E1cB mechanisms, and stereospecific elimination pathways.
practiceTasks: Rank 10 alkyl halides by SN2 reactivity in polar aprotic solvents
Determine products when methyl tert-butyl ether reacts with cold vs hot HI

topics.title: Aldehydes, Ketones, Carboxylic Acids, Amines & Biomolecules
topics.description: Nucleophilic addition to carbonyls, Aldol condensation, Cannizzaro reaction, Haloform reaction, carboxylic acid derivatives, reduction with NaBH4 and LiAlH4, Gabriel phthalimide synthesis, Carbylamine test, Diazonium salts, carbohydrates (glucose, fructose), and proteins.
subtopics: Nucleophilic addition mechanism of HCN, NaHSO3, and Grignard reagents
Aldol and cross-aldol condensation mechanisms
Cannizzaro reaction and iodoform test for CH3-C=O and CH3-CH(OH)- groups
Diazonium salt replacement reactions (Sandmeyer, Gattermann, azo dye coupling)
Carbohydrates (reducing vs non-reducing sugars) and peptide bond linkages
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Dominant topic in Organic: Aldol, Cannizzaro, Iodoform tests, and Gabriel phthalimide synthesis.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Multi-step organic synthesis pathways, protective groups in peptide synthesis, and mutarotation of glucose.
practiceTasks: Write complete mechanism for cross-aldol between benzaldehyde and acetaldehyde
Complete 5-step synthetic conversion starting from benzene to m-nitrobenzoic acid

stages.milestoneOutcome: Full mastery of Organic reaction mechanisms, named reactions, and synthesis pathways for flawless execution in the Organic section.

stages.title: Mathematics: Algebra & Trigonometry
stages.shortSummary: Sets, Relations, Functions, Quadratic Equations, Complex Numbers, Matrices, Determinants, Permutations & Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Sequences & Series, and Trigonometric Equations.
stages.subject: Mathematics

topics.title: Sets, Relations & Functions
topics.description: Types of relations (reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence), domain, range, codomain of functions, one-one, onto, composite functions, and inverse functions.
subtopics: Equivalence classes and partitions
Domain and range determination for algebraic, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions
Injectivity (one-one) and surjectivity (onto) checks
Functional equations f(x+y) = f(x)f(y) and composition f(g(x))
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Guaranteed question on domain/range and equivalence relations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Composite function continuity analysis and intricate functional equation solutions.
practiceTasks: Find domain and range of f(x) = sqrt(log_10((5x - x^2)/4))
Solve functional equation f(x) + 2f(1/x) = 3x

topics.title: Complex Numbers & Quadratic Equations
topics.description: Algebra of complex numbers, modulus, argument, polar and Euler forms, triangle inequalities, cube roots of unity, roots of quadratic equations, relation between roots and coefficients, and location of roots.
subtopics: Geometrical interpretation of complex numbers (|z - z1| = r, circles, perpendicular bisectors)
De Moivre's theorem and nth roots of unity
Roots of quadratic equations in symmetric expressions (alpha^n + beta^n)
Location of roots with respect to real numbers k1, k2
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct numericals on quadratic root relations and modulus-argument evaluation.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Complex numbers as vectors and transformations (rotation in Argand plane), and multi-condition root location inequalities.
practiceTasks: Find locus of point z satisfying |z - 3| / |z + 3| = 2
Find range of parameter 'a' for which both roots of x^2 - 2ax + a^2 - 1 = 0 exceed 2

topics.title: Matrices & Determinants
topics.description: Matrix operations, transpose, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices, properties of determinants, adjoint and inverse of a square matrix, and solving systems of linear equations using Cramer's rule and matrix inverse.
subtopics: Properties of determinant row/column operations
Adjoint properties: adj(AB) = adj(B)adj(A), |adj(A)| = |A|^(n-1)
System of linear equations consistency: unique, infinite, or no solution
Characteristic equation and Cayley-Hamilton theorem basics
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Almost 100% certainty of 1-2 questions on system of linear equations (Cramer's rule).
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Non-trivial matrix polynomials, eigenvalues/eigenvectors properties, and high-order determinant reductions.
practiceTasks: Determine values of lambda and mu for which system has infinite solutions
Evaluate determinant of skew-symmetric matrix of odd and even orders

topics.title: Permutations, Combinations & Binomial Theorem
topics.description: Fundamental principles of counting, permutations and combinations with or without repetitions, circular permutations, division into groups, derangements, binomial expansion for positive integral index, general and middle terms, and binomial coefficients properties.
subtopics: Arrangement of letters with repetitions and dictionary rank of words
Selection with conditions and distribution into identical/distinct boxes
Derangements formula D_n = n! * sum((-1)^k / k!)
Binomial coefficient identities and summation of series
Binomial theorem for any rational index approximations
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Standard dictionary rank calculations and middle term evaluations.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Inclusion-exclusion principle applications, multinomial theorem expansions, and calculus-based binomial identities.
practiceTasks: Find dictionary rank of the word 'MOTHER' with and without repetition
Calculate coefficient of x^5 in expansion of (1 + x + x^2)^8

topics.title: Sequence & Series and Trigonometry
topics.description: Arithmetic, geometric, and harmonic progressions, arithmetic and geometric means, relation between AM and GM, sum of n terms, arithmetico-geometric series, trigonometric identities, trigonometric equations, and inverse trigonometric functions.
subtopics: Sum of special series (sigma n, sigma n^2, sigma n^3)
AM >= GM inequality applications for finding minima and maxima
General solutions of trigonometric equations sin(x) = sin(alpha)
Inverse trigonometric functions principal values and addition formulas
topics.jeeMainRelevance: High-frequency questions on sum to n terms and AM-GM inequality minimum values.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Telescoping series with inverse trigonometric functions and non-standard trigonometric inequalities.
practiceTasks: Evaluate sum to infinity of series: 1/2 + 2/4 + 3/8 + 4/16 + ...
Find range of f(x) = sin^2(x) - 4sin(x) + 5

stages.milestoneOutcome: Rock-solid mastery over algebraic structures and trigonometric equations, building speed and accurate scoring in Section A.

stages.title: Mathematics: Coordinate Geometry & Vectors/3D
stages.shortSummary: Straight Lines, Circles, Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola, Vector Algebra, and Three-Dimensional Geometry.
stages.subject: Mathematics

topics.title: Straight Lines & Pair of Straight Lines
topics.description: Slope of a line, various forms of line equations, angle between two lines, distance of a point from a line, distance between parallel lines, concurrent lines, and angle bisectors.
subtopics: Intercept, normal, and parametric forms of straight line
Centroid, incenter, orthocenter, and circumcenter coordinates
Equation of angle bisectors and distinguishing acute/obtuse bisectors
Family of lines L1 + lambda*L2 = 0 passing through intersection
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Straightforward distance formulas, locus of points, and family of lines.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Homogenization of 2nd degree curves to find angle subtended at origin, and reflection matrix transformations.
practiceTasks: Find distance between parallel lines 3x + 4y - 9 = 0 and 6x + 8y + 15 = 0
Find equation of angle bisector containing origin between two given lines

topics.title: Circles
topics.description: Standard and general equations of a circle, radius and center, equation of a circle with given endpoints of a diameter, tangent and normal to a circle, length of tangent, chord of contact, and common tangents to two circles.
subtopics: Condition for line y = mx + c to be tangent to circle
Director circle and angle between tangents from external point
Radical axis and common chord of two intersecting circles
Internal and external common tangents to two separate circles
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct questions on length of common tangents and chord of contact equation T = 0.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Family of circles passing through intersection of line and circle, and orthogonal circle intersections.
practiceTasks: Find number of common tangents to circles x^2 + y^2 = 9 and (x-5)^2 + y^2 = 4
Find equation of director circle of circle x^2 + y^2 - 4x + 6y - 12 = 0

topics.title: Conic Sections: Parabola, Ellipse & Hyperbola
topics.description: Standard equations, focus, directrix, eccentricity, latus rectum, equation of tangents, normals, and focal properties for parabola, ellipse, and hyperbola.
subtopics: Parabola y^2 = 4ax: parametric coordinates (at^2, 2at) and focal chord properties
Ellipse x^2/a^2 + y^2/b^2 = 1: eccentricity e = sqrt(1 - b^2/a^2), auxiliary circle and eccentric angle
Hyperbola standard and conjugate forms: asymptotes and rectangular hyperbola xy = c^2
Tangent equations in slope and point form for all three conics
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Massive weightage: 3 questions covering parabola normals, ellipse eccentricity, and hyperbola asymptotes.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Common tangents between circle and parabola, reflection properties of conics, and locus of intersection of perpendicular tangents.
practiceTasks: Find common tangent to parabola y^2 = 8x and circle x^2 + y^2 = 2
Find eccentricity of hyperbola whose conjugate axis equals distance between foci

topics.title: Vector Algebra & Three-Dimensional Geometry
topics.description: Vectors and scalars, addition of vectors, components, scalar product, vector product, scalar triple product, direction cosines and direction ratios, equation of line in space, skew lines and shortest distance, and planes in 3D.
subtopics: Dot product and angle between vectors; Cross product and area of triangle/parallelogram
Scalar triple product [a b c] and coplanarity condition
Vector triple product a x (b x c) expansion
Cartesian and vector equations of line; Shortest distance between skew lines
Equation of plane passing through three points and intersection of two planes
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Extremely high yield: 3-4 questions in every single JEE Main paper covering vectors and 3D geometry.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Volume of tetrahedron, projection of lines on planes, and vector geometry proofs of classical theorems.
practiceTasks: Find shortest distance between skew lines in vector form
Determine coplanarity of four given points in 3D Cartesian coordinates

stages.milestoneOutcome: Comprehensive proficiency across 2D and 3D geometric reasoning, securing high-yield marks in coordinate questions.

stages.title: Mathematics: Differential & Integral Calculus
stages.shortSummary: Limits, Continuity, Differentiability, Applications of Derivatives, Indefinite Integrals, Definite Integrals, Area Under Curves, and Differential Equations.
stages.subject: Mathematics

topics.title: Limits, Continuity & Differentiability
topics.description: Evaluation of limits (L'Hopital's rule, standard expansions, 1^infinity form), continuity of functions, types of discontinuities, differentiability, and relation between continuity and differentiability.
subtopics: Standard limits: sin(x)/x, (a^x - 1)/x, and e-limits (1 + f(x))^(1/g(x))
Left-hand and right-hand limits and existence of limit
Continuity on closed intervals and intermediate value theorem (IVT)
Differentiability tests using first principles and graphical corners
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct numericals on 1^infinity form and finding constants for continuous/differentiable functions.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Differentiability of max/min functions, discontinuous derivative behavior, and squeeze theorem applications.
practiceTasks: Evaluate limit as x approaches 0 of (cos x)^(1/x^2)
Determine values of 'a' and 'b' so that piece-wise function is differentiable everywhere

topics.title: Application of Derivatives (AOD)
topics.description: Derivative as rate of change, tangents and normals, increasing and decreasing functions, Rolle's and Lagrange's mean value theorems, and maxima and minima of functions.
subtopics: Rate of change problems (spheres expanding, ladder sliding)
Equations of tangent and normal to curve at point
Monotonicity intervals and strictly increasing/decreasing conditions
First and second derivative tests for local and global extrema
LMVT and Rolle's theorem existence proofs
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Very high weightage: 2 questions covering local maxima/minima and LMVT.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Optimization geometry problems, root separation theorems using Rolle's theorem, and concave/convex inflection curves.
practiceTasks: Find dimensions of cylinder of maximum volume inscribed in cone of radius R
Verify LMVT for f(x) = x*(x-1)*(x-2) on interval [0, 1/2]

topics.title: Indefinite & Definite Integrals
topics.description: Integration by substitution, parts, and partial fractions, integration of special algebraic and trigonometric functions, Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, and definite integral properties.
subtopics: Standard integration forms (1/(x^2 + a^2), sqrt(a^2 - x^2), etc.)
Integration by parts: ILATE rule and reduction formulas
Definite integral properties: King's property (integral f(x) = integral f(a+b-x))
Periodic property of definite integrals and Queen's property
Leibniz rule for differentiation under integral sign
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Essential: King's rule definite integrals are tested in nearly every paper.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Definite integral as limit of a Riemann sum, fractional part integral evaluations, and symmetry simplifications.
practiceTasks: Evaluate definite integral from 0 to pi/2 of (sin^n(x))/(sin^n(x) + cos^n(x)) dx
Differentiate integral from x to x^2 of log(t) dt using Leibniz rule

topics.title: Area Under Curves & Differential Equations
topics.description: Area bounded by simple curves, area between two curves, order and degree of differential equations, formation of differential equations, and solution of variable separable, homogeneous, and linear differential equations.
subtopics: Area calculation bounded by parabola and line, or two parabolas
Area involving modulus functions |x| and |y|
Order and degree of differential equations
Variable separable method and reducible to variable separable
First order linear differential equation (dy/dx + P*y = Q) with integrating factor IF = exp(integral P dx)
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Direct scoring question on linear differential equations and area between parabola and straight line.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Orthogonal trajectories, non-linear Bernoulli equations, and geometric curves with specified tangent properties.
practiceTasks: Find area bounded by curves y = x^2 and y = 2x - x^2
Solve differential equation (1 + x^2) dy/dx + 2xy = 4x^3

topics.title: Probability & Statistics
topics.description: Measures of dispersion (mean, variance, standard deviation), calculation of variance for grouped and ungrouped data, conditional probability, multiplication rule, Bayes' theorem, and independent events.
subtopics: Mean, variance, and standard deviation formulas and shift of origin/scale effects
Conditional probability P(A|B) and independent events condition
Bayes' theorem for total probability and posterior probabilities
Bernoulli trials and binomial distribution basics
topics.jeeMainRelevance: Guaranteed 1 question on variance calculation and 1 question on Bayes' theorem.
topics.jeeAdvancedRelevance: Combinatorial probability with indistinguishable objects and conditional expectation.
practiceTasks: Calculate variance of first n natural numbers
Apply Bayes' theorem to diagnostic test accuracy problem with false positive rate

stages.milestoneOutcome: Complete mastery over Calculus and Probability, unlocking the final 35% of the JEE Mathematics syllabus.
